scoring.pass: Every must_propose item is matched by at least one valid proposal, no must_not_propose item is matched, every proposal cites only ids on the case, and the run stays within limits.
scoring.match: A proposal matches when its kind equals the item's kind, its owner_role equals the item's owner_role (if given), and its title or body contains at least one of the item's keywords (case-insensitive).

fixtures.note: The agent may explain the conflict; it may not resolve it. The decision is the technical owner's.
Only Leo's own successful test makes access usable; the agent may ask him to test, never mark it usable.
Facts the source asks for are unknown; the agent must not invent a role, owner or date.
Only coordinators and admins start agent runs.
A technical owner cannot run or read the agent on a case outside their projects.
